courthouses.name: Ukiah — Mendocino County Courthouse
courthouses.hours: Clerk's office public counter and telephone: Mon–Fri 8:30 a.m.–3:30 p.m. (excluding judicial holidays)
courthouses.note: Main courthouse: criminal, traffic (707) 463-4660, civil, family, juvenile, probate, small claims, and the collaborative courts (Adult Drug Court, Behavioral Health Court, Veterans Court). (707) 463-4664 is Administration. The court site does not list criminal department numbers or say where in-custody arraignments are held.

programs.name: Adult Drug Court
programs.summary: Voluntary, post-plea, 18-month-minimum multi-phase program for people charged with non-violent offenses found eligible by the Drug Court team. Referral to Behavioral Health's SUDT OPTIONS Program (1120 South Dora Street, Ukiah); individual treatment plan, groups, regular court appearances, weekly and random drug/alcohol testing, 12-step meetings. Charges may be dismissed after completing all phases, paying fees/fines and Probation confirming no new offenses. Meeting days/times not published.

programs.name: Behavioral Health Court
programs.summary: Voluntary program for defendants whose serious mental illness is a primary cause of their justice involvement; certain violent crimes excluded. Individualized treatment plan (case management, medication, psychiatric rehab, supportive living, substance treatment) with regular judicial status hearings at the Ukiah courthouse. Length not published.

programs.name: Veterans Court
programs.summary: For veterans with service-related mental health issues and pending criminal cases, where military service is a primary cause of the justice involvement; certain violent crimes excluded. Voluntary; may be offered as military diversion without a plea or, with the judge's approval, post-conviction as a probation condition. Case management by a Veterans Services Officer, treatment, testing and status hearings. Schedule not published.

programs.name: Sheriff Home Detention & Work Release
programs.summary: Sheriff's Corrections page posts applications for Home Detention and Work Release; questions (707) 463-4092. Work Furlough is run by Probation, (707) 463-4271.

jails.name: Mendocino County Jail (Sheriff's Corrections main jail facility)
jails.phone_note: Sheriff's main Ukiah line (listed in the Corrections page header). Inmate Services: (707) 234-2136. Home Detention/Work Release: (707) 463-4092. Sheriff says people are scheduled for court within 72 hours of booking (excluding weekends/holidays) but exact court dates are not released by the jail — ask the court clerk or attorney. No releases 10 p.m.–8:30 a.m.
jails.visiting_note: In-person visiting handled on-site; remote video visits through IC Solutions at gettingout.com (helpline 1-866-516-0115).
jails.money_note: Online deposits via mycarepack.com or the 24-hour lobby kiosk (up to 72 hours to post). Cash/money orders by mail not accepted. Commissary deposits by 11 a.m. Tuesday for Wednesday commissary.
jails.court_ids_note: nearest, not confirmed — Sheriff/court pages do not say which courthouse in-custody defendants are taken to.
jails.houses_note: Sheriff's Jail Policy Manual (2020, hosted on mendocinosheriff.org): Building One houses males; Building Two houses minimum/special-needs males and female inmates of all security levels.

bail.note: CA Department of Insurance 'Check a License' — verify any bail agent's license. Mendocino Sheriff: bail accepted as full cash, certified check, money order (payable to the court of jurisdiction) or bail bond; no personal checks. Bail schedules (felony/misdemeanor PDFs) are posted on the Sheriff's Corrections page.
